fixes.explanation: God does say to place the ark of the Testimony behind the veil, with the mercy seat on top (Exodus 26:33-34). But the table and the lampstand don't go back there. The instruction puts them outside the veil, the table on the north side and the lampstand opposite it on the south (Exodus 26:35).

Bronze it is, baker! The altar is overlaid with bronze, and the instruction says, "Make all its utensils of bronze…" (Exodus 27:3). Then the grate is bronze mesh with bronze rings (Exodus 27:4), the poles are overlaid with bronze (Exodus 27:6), and even the tent pegs are bronze (Exodus 27:19). Pots, shovels, bowls, forks, firepans, all one metal. I own one apron and still manage to mix it up with my other apron, which is the same apron.

All the time is right, baker. The oil of pressed olives is for the light, and the lamps are to keep burning continually (Exodus 27:20). Then Aaron and his sons are to tend them "from evening until morning" (Exodus 27:21). Evening until morning! I fall asleep waiting for one batch to cool, so I'd be the worst lamp crew in the camp.
